description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink project and handles importing test cases from Mantis XML issues. It includes functions for processing uploaded XML files, parsing test case data from XML, and importing them into the test management system, with support for deduplication, user mapping, and project-specific configurations.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user in the TestLink system, used for mapping author logins to user IDs.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Represents a test case entity within the system, with methods for creation, updating, and duplicate detection.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Represents a test project, used for managing project-specific configurations.

classes.name: tree
classes.description: Manages hierarchical structures of test suites and cases within projects.

classes.name: tlString
classes.description: Provides string utility functions like length measurement and substring.

methods.name: importIssueFromXML
methods.description: Imports test cases from an XML file into the project, optionally handling recursion and duplication logic.

methods.name: saveImportedTCData
methods.description: Stores imported test case data into the database, with validation and management of custom fields and requirements.

methods.name: getTestCaseSetFromIssueSimpleXMLObj
methods.description: Extracts test case data from a simple XML object representing Mantis issues.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes GUI parameters and temporary file paths for the import process.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and cleans up request arguments for the import request.
